Method of Attack: Records all user's keystrokes and saves to a local file accessible to anyone or malware
Writes all keystrokes to a local file C:\users\public\MicTray.log
Exposes keystrokes in real-time via local OutputDebugString API allowing covert channel for malware to record keystrokes
Impacted Systems: HP Elite x2 1012 G1 with Travel Keyboard
HP Elite x2 1012 G1 Advanced Keyboard
HP EliteBook Folio 1040 G3 Notebook PC
HP ZBook Studio G3 Mobile Workstation
HP EliteBook Folio G1 Notebook PC
Attack Vector: Preinstalled audio driver on HP laptops
MicTray64.exe registered to start via Scheduled Task at user login
Local file logging and local API OutputDebugString for keystroke capture
Indicators of Compromise: Keystroke data logged in MicTray.log file
